verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's docs describe prebuilt UIs that remove the need for a custom payment UI. The marketing page describes an online checkout with smart payment ordering and speed, which supports the conversion-optimized claim, and payment links imply a vendor-hosted payment page. However, no evidence documents a redirect-based hosted checkout flow for developers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of redirecting customers to a Flutterwave-hosted checkout URL, integration details (API call returning a checkout link, redirect/callback handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversion-optimization claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Our online checkout features our smart payment ordering system, incredible speed, and beautiful simplicity.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
